encounter.title: Prologue mini-boss — PROVISIONAL (shortlist #1, seed 2908)
encounter.notes: EXP-008 demo only, not chosen by the user. Phase 1: boss on the right, 4 of 9 E arrows are free at start. Phase 2: boss moves up; the board has a single N arrow for 5 hp, so the fight is provably lost without Rotate (max 5/9). Rotate cw turns 8 W arrows to N, ccw turns the remaining E arrows to N; both win.
